dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Hello! Welcome to Ogura Textiles & Kimonos.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: The high-class silks from Liyue are still out of stock, but we have many new kimonos. Feel free to have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: May I ask who you are?

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: I am Ogura Mio, the owner of Ogura Textiles & Kimonos. Let me know if you need anything.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Ogura Textiles & Kimonos is a family-run store that has been around for a century. We sell high-class fabrics and the latest kimonos. Those upper-class samurai often come here as well. The quality of our merchandise is guaranteed.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: I see that you are not dressed commonly either. I'd wager that you've probably seen much. So, would you like to try out some Inazuma-style outfits?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the issue with the silks from Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Because of the Sakoku Decree, many merchants engaged in international trade have been forced to shutter their businesses. The same goes for the import-export fabric industry.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: The dye houses of Ritou have closed down, and the dyes grown in Konda Village don't sell for good prices anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Because of the difficulty in trading with Liyue, its price was driven up. It has also been out of stock for a long time, in any case.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: In the past, one could touch the silk weaved from Silk Flowers and have a sneak peek at the exotic lifestyle of the upper class in other lands. Now, I have almost forgotten what that smooth texture feels like...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you! Goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Take care! Come back any time.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Oh my, if it isn't Miss Kamisato's friend?

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Long time no see. Please, come in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to thank you again for that commission last time.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: You're welcome. It is the honor of Ogura Textiles & Kimonos to be able to make a customized outfit for Miss Kamisato.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: In any case, I rarely see Miss Kamisato so casual and happy. You two must be truly close friends.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Ah, seeing how you're so close to Miss Kamisato, I'm getting curious as to what your story is, my dear customer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, how've things been going lately?

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: It's still the same. The last time I got my hands on Liyue silk was when I was making that outfit for Miss Kamisato. My brother is also still somewhere far away...

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Ah, why am I saying these things to a customer? I'm sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: On the upside, business has been good and my brother is safe, so everything is going well.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: If you ever run into my brother, please send him my regards. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Take care! Please send my regards to Miss Kamisato as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business?

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Thank you for asking.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Although stocks of fabric are a bit tight, We are a storied and well-known store after all. Our items are excellent and have a good reputation.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Furthermore, my brother is a sergeant serving in the Shogun's Army, so we have the honor of offering our services to many officials of the Tenryou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Most officers of the Tenryou Commission are high-class samurai, and they have many family members who often come here to purchase expensive, high-end kimonos. Our business is doing well thanks to them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Should have brought some from Liyue, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Ah, have you been to Liyue before?

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: I was right after all. Judging from your outfit, I knew that you were a traveler from afar.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: If you happen to come into possession of silk weaved from Silk Flowers at Liyue's Feiyun Commerce Guild, we will be happy to buy them for a reasonable price.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, you mentioned your brother...

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: I have a samurai brother who is stationed afar and cannot return home yet.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Ever since my father's passing, the store that my brother should have been taking care of was left to me instead.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Although we cannot meet, we still keep writing to each other. I'm glad that we're aware of each other's well-being.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm just a passing traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: You jest again, dear customer... But since you insist on keeping it a secret, I will not pry.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Ogura Textiles & Kimonos will continue to count on you and Miss Kamisato for business.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How've things been going lately?

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Things are going well. Thank you for asking.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: With the trade routes re-opened, many customers have recently come to order silks. I have several pages' worth of names, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: If you're looking to buy any now, I'm afraid that you might have to wait a few months.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's at times like these that I wish that my brother, stationed afar as he is, could return to help out...

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: Ah, why am I saying these things to a customer? I'm sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Mio
dialogues.text: If you ever run into my brother, please send him my regards. Thank you.
